headline: Continuous Pigmentation Cline

items.title: Huxley 1938 cline
items.detail: Polygenic skin-reflectance gradient correlated with latitude and UV radiation.

items.title: Jablonski & Chaplin 2000
items.detail: Folate protection versus vitamin D synthesis across environments.

items.title: Crawford et al. 2017
items.detail: Four loci explain ~29% of measured pigmentation variance across N = 2,092 Africans.

items.title: La Braña 7 ka
items.detail: A 7,000-year-old genome carries dark-skin alleles with a blue-eye haplotype (Olalde et al. 2014).

items.title: Cheddar Man
items.detail: Mesolithic Britain: dark-to-black skin with blue/green eyes (Brace et al. 2019).

sources: The Original Power, Ch. 2, §2.3; Huxley (1938); Jablonski & Chaplin (2000); Crawford et al. (2017)
